explication: Chart.js is a JavaScript canvas charting library. A developer supplies chart configuration and data through the public API; the chart controller resolves configuration, selects a platform, parses datasets, builds scales and layout, computes chart-specific geometry, animates updates, and draws to a canvas. Pointer events flow back through platform and interaction handling, while registered plugins add legends, titles, tooltips, colors, filling, and decimation. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime paths; some controller and plugin relationships are represented at directory/index level.
